note: Three real briefs, one per topic of evals/knowledge-pages/corpus. frozenSources point to the committed abstracts (textPath is relative to evals/knowledge-pages); existingPages is empty because each brief is a first compile. The job-level harness that runs them against the model is run_eval.mjs (arm B).

briefs.title: Eight atrial fibrillation anticoagulant abstracts: four pivotal DOAC trials, three restricted-population trials and a pooled analysis
briefs.why: The same drug at two doses (RE-LY, ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48), a per-protocol and an intention-to-treat result in one trial (ROCKET AF), three different comparators (warfarin, aspirin, placebo) and a pooled analysis that restates trial findings. A compiler that flattens these into one tidy statement per drug writes sentences no abstract supports.

existingPages.note: First compile of the project: no page exists yet, so every page in the patch is an op "create".

mustDo: Give every sentence of every page at least one verbatim quotation (10 to 600 characters) copied from the document it comes from, and keep the numbers, units and conditions the quotation carries.
Write pages by subject (a drug, a trial family, a question the documents answer), not one page per abstract; merge synonyms and abbreviations under one title.
Mark a statement across documents `synthesized`, with quotations from at least two different documents and a confidence word; mark everything else `direct`.
Keep the `related` links to pages that exist or that the same patch creates.
Write the pages in the language of the documents and copy knowledge-compile-input.json unchanged into the deliverable beside wiki-patch.json.

Keep the doses of RE-LY (110 mg and 150 mg) and of ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 (high and low) as separate findings, and the per-protocol and intention-to-treat results of ROCKET AF with their analysis population.
Say, for AVERROES and ELDERCARE-AF, which comparator (aspirin, placebo) and which population (patients unsuitable for vitamin K antagonists; people aged 80 or more) each result belongs to.

Write at least one cross-trial statement (for example major bleeding against warfarin across the four pivotal trials, or the meta-analysis beside the trials it pools) as `synthesized`, and report differences of design or population between documents in `lint` with kind `conflict`.
mustNotDo: Write a per-document summary page, an index page, or a sentence about the researcher, the platform, tools or how the pages were made.
State a number, a population or a verb stronger than the quotations behind the sentence hold.
Quote text that is not in the document, translate a quotation, or tidy its punctuation.
Present AVERROES, ELDERCARE-AF or J-ROCKET AF results as comparisons with the warfarin of the pivotal trials, or average the two doses of a trial into one result.
briefs.gradedOn: The share of sentences the platform confirms against the full abstracts (held sentences are counted, not hidden); whether doses, analysis populations and comparators stay attached to their numbers; whether cross-trial statements are synthesized with two documents and a confidence word; and, in the three-arm harness, whether answers to cross-document questions improve over search alone.

briefs.title: Eight SGLT2 inhibitor abstracts: four heart failure trials across the ejection fraction range, three chronic kidney disease trials and a heart failure meta-analysis
briefs.why: Hazard ratios from different primary composites (worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death; cardiovascular death or heart failure hospitalization; kidney composites) look alike and are not interchangeable, eligibility differs by ejection fraction, eGFR, albuminuria and diabetes, and all-cause death falls in some trials and not in others. A compiler that merges them reports effects no document states.

briefs.title: Eight aspirin primary prevention abstracts: four trials in different populations, two pooled analyses and a guideline statement
briefs.why: ASCEND found fewer vascular events and more bleeding, ARRIVE, ASPREE and JPPP found no significant reduction, ASPREE found higher all-cause and cancer mortality, two pooled analyses frame the net balance differently, and a guideline statement turns the evidence into age-based recommendations. Each document answers a different question for a different population; a compiler that issues one verdict states what no document concludes.
